title: A matching dictator transcript for embedded majority
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester for functions from $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{-1,1\}$ with two queries, a finite seed space, and a probability law on its seeds. For any odd natural number $d\le n$ and any seed of $T$, there is a coordinate dictator whose answered query transcript agrees exactly with that of majority on the first $d$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive two-query tester from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the sign set
The tester has a finite seed space and a probability law on its seeds
